page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head above the text with the page number at top right; catchword "Deus" at the bottom right.

main_text.p: Sed nec isti spurci adeo & infames Libelli (velut Ignis in magna conflagratione fusque deque volitantes, ut omnia inflamment) mihi magis in probrum quam ipsis cedent, qui eximiam pietatem professi, ita parum se memores oftendunt vel in Deum vel in Me, officii, ut nec tantillum curaverint Majestatem Regis sui vindicare ab eorum calumniis, qui & Dei praecepto & Angelorum exemplo contrarii, dignitates probris lacessunt, & maledicti notam iis impingunt qui Deorum nomine honorantur.
At haud mirum, si, qui Deum non me-tuant, nec Regem suum revereantur.

Facilè enim contemnent has Umbras Dei, & Imagines, qui Supremæ Illius & Adorandæ Majestatis reverentiam exuerint, cui collata omnis hominum & Angelorum gloria sordes duntaxat & tenebrae: qui tamen (tanto licet intervallo disjunctis) eos Regibus Divinæ Authoritatis & Sacrosanctæ Potestatis Characteras impressit, qui sine gravi peccato obliterari non possunt. Quicquid nigri hic veli oppositerint, non abscondetur lumen vultus mei, dum mihi Deus cor dederit ad frequenter & humiliter cum illo versandum, à quo vera omnis Gloria & Majestas derivatur.

page.notes: The running head Greek word is printed as ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ; its sigma is drawn in a form close to Z, so the reading is marked [?]. The text "oppofuerint" is printed with long s and is transcribed as "oppositerint"; please check this word, as the scan is soft there. Long s has been normalised to s throughout ("isti", "professi", "lacessunt", "impressit"). Tall-s "fufque" is read as "fusque".
